prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a snowy town square. On the left, a man in a red scarf stands firmly on the icy pavement. In the center, a brown dog sits patiently beside him, its fur dusted with fresh snowflakes. To the right, a woman in a blue coat looks intently at the animal. The man extends his hand toward the dog, offering a small treat that the creature eyes with anticipation. The scene is quiet and still, focused entirely on this brief moment of connection amidst the winter chill. There is no bird flying overhead to distract from the central trio. The background features blurred historic buildings, emphasizing the three main subjects in the foreground. The snow covers the ground uniformly, creating a soft white base for the figures.
